texts:
Friday's final injury reports are in, and Seattle had the late surprise.

Jadarian Price is out with the chest.

Emanuel Wilson moves up to RB31 for me, a low-end RB3, splitting the work with Holani.

Let's dive in.
#Seahawks

Ruled out, with the pivot:

Justin Jefferson: pivot to Jordan Addison, WR25.

DeVonta Smith: pivot to Dontayvion Wicks, WR33.

Dallas Goedert: pivot to Juwan Johnson, TE8.

Breece Hall: pivot to Braelon Allen, RB20.
#Skol #FlyEaglesFly #Saints #JetUp

More outs:

Jayden Daniels: pivot to Marcus Mariota, a streamer at QB17.

Rachaad White: Jacory Croskey-Merritt is RB24, an RB2.

Caleb Williams: pivot to Jared Goff, QB8.

No fantasy starter is doubtful this week.
#RaiseHail #DaBears #OnePride

Questionable, with Friday's practice:

Keenan Allen missed Friday after two limited days. WR36, a low-end WR3 if active.

Kenyon Sadiq was limited all week. TE14, a borderline start.

Ladd McConkey was limited Friday. WR40, a low-end flex play.
#ForTheShoe #JetUp #BoltUp

One more questionable:

Zay Flowers was limited Friday, listed as rest, after a full Thursday with the hamstring. WR9 for me vs TEN; check the 11:30 AM ET inactives.
#RavensFlock

Cleared to play:

Nico Collins practiced in full Friday. WR13, borderline WR1/WR2.

DJ Moore has no designation after limited practices. WR23, a WR2.

Tyjae Spears practiced in full Friday but is RB39 behind Pollard; sit him.
#HTownMade #BillsMafia #TitanUp

Sunday morning decisions in London, inactives at 8:00 AM ET:

Keenan Allen (groin), a low-end WR3 if active.

Terry McLaurin (hamstring), WR41; have Stefon Diggs or a 1 PM receiver ready.
#ForTheShoe #RaiseHail

Later decisions:

Ladd McConkey (foot): inactives at 2:55 PM ET.

Mike Evans (ribs): 2:55 PM ET, a dart throw at best.

Jalen Coker (quad): 6:50 PM ET. If he sits, Darren Waller is a tight end streamer.
#BoltUp #FTTB #KeepPounding

Every designation, practice report and pivot is in Prep Notes on the site, with the Menu refreshed.
Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Sunday's inactives and pivots, and repost this for your league.
